name: PRs in Binondo 2025
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2Nzg4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e0c0aa540c48dc90b9c4013e25719f9def41f9d4/IMG_6671.png) Welcome to PRs in Binondo! 2025, the second speedcubing competition at the oldest Chinatown in the world! This competition will feature a speedcubing twist where all the rounds of a single event is held consecutively, simulating a PR worth environment. The events of this competition are 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multiblind, Megaminx and 4x4 Blindfolded with **4x4** as the main event. We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing. This competition is hosted by **Cubers and Friends**.
